description:
Somos a Lunar Gamers, uma equipe que se reuniu por fazer parte de um clubinho de ciências. Gostamos de aprender, compartilhar ideias e criar coisas novas. Nosso interesse pela Lua nos motivou a explorar mais sobre ela e transformar nossas descobertas em um projeto divertido e educativo.

#LUNARGAMERS
summary: Lunar Gamers is an educational Scratch game created by children for players aged 7 and up. The player joins a lunar mission and helps an astronaut crew keep a Moon base operating for 72 hours. Players monitor essential supplies—oxygen, water, food, and energy—and make choices about exploring the lunar surface and using the base’s resources. Each decision can affect the crew’s ability to continue the mission and return safely to Earth. Inspired by information from NASA, the game turns ideas about lunar exploration, life-support needs, and the Moon’s water ice into an interactive experience. By combining a story, player choices, and student-created artwork and programming, Lunar Gamers encourages scientific curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork.
details:
Lunar Gamers is an educational game created by children in Scratch for players aged 7 and up. The player joins a four-astronaut crew on a 72-hour mission to a lunar base. During the mission, players monitor oxygen, water, food, and energy; choose whether to explore on foot or by rover; and decide whether to use energy to process lunar ice into water and hydrogen. Exploration consumes resources, so players must keep each resource above 10% and finish the mission with at least 50% oxygen for the crew’s return to Earth. The game is based on research about the Moon and lunar resources, including NASA educational materials. The children planned and programmed the game in Scratch, and Canva was used to prepare the presentation. ChatGPT helped draft and translate some text and create or edit some visual assets. The game turns science concepts into an interactive story and encourages curiosity, teamwork, and problem-solving.
